title: Contact
bodyHtml:
We welcome your questions and feedback about how we can improve PanKbase! Please contact us through our Community Forum on GitHub or email us at help@pankbase.org. If you are reporting a bug, please include the URL of the page you are viewing. We endeavor to answer all queries within two business days.

Feedback

We value your feedback and strive to continuously update our resource to reflect the needs of the community. Please fill out our survey here.
